primary_decision.expand: Proceed to a second separately frozen eligible Development task only if at least one no-fix control is accepted in original/source-only, both no-fix controls are rejected in fully-sanitized, the genuine fix is accepted in all three images, and baseline plus both mutants are rejected in all three.
primary_decision.stop: Otherwise stop cross-task expansion and report the failed condition or genuine-fix rejection; do not relax the protocol or change candidates after results.
